# glosings0n | Georges Byona

Official portfolio of Georges Byona (@glosings0n / @losingson).
Founder & Software Engineer @ MusanTek | Edge-AI Researcher @ SautiLM, small language models for African languages | Founder @ FlutterFire Summer Camp, 1,000+ participants across French-speaking Africa | Former GDG on Campus UCB Bukavu Lead, 500+ students trained | Offline-first Flutter and on-device AI | Speaker at droidcon, flutterCon, DevFest and Google I/O Extended.
